messages:
Liz (CS): handing off Emberly pilot — signed 30d pilot begins today. Primary asks: SAML SSO, VPC peering for private eval, and capacity for ~300-500 rps during scheduled throughput tests. Decision review in ~60d; potential upsell on success.
Omar (Sales): Confirmed pilot MSA. We promised a reserved slot and up to 3 GPU burst. Billing contact: jen@emberly.com.
Maya (Success Manager): Ive scheduled 30/45/55d touches in Gainsight and set health monitor. Will track calls, API success rate, 95p latency.
Priya (Support): please paste SAML metadata and customer peer CIDR so I can open a high-priority ticket.
Liz (CS): attaching SAML xml in the ticket. Customer expects peer CIDR 10.50.0.0/16 and strict egress rules.
Ben (Eng): two quick Qs: are we okay to run quantized-v2 for pilot? Any custom model weights or prompt repos to preload?
Omar (Sales): want parity with hosted outputs; no custom weights. They have a few system prompts for triage flows — will share. quantized-v2 ok for pilot.
Priya (Support): opened CS-4822: "Emberly pilot — SAML + VPC peering + reserved capacity". Assignees: @ben_eng, @liz_cs. ETA 48h for peering validation.
onboard-bot: Ticket CS-4822 created by Priya. ETA: 48h.
Ben (Eng): Eng action items: (1) validate VPC peering and run connectivity smoke tests, (2) stage SAML on test IdP, (3) allocate reserved slot and run sanity generation on quantized-v2.
Liz (CS): Owners: Ben (eng), Priya (support), Maya (success), Omar (sales). Next steps: Ben to confirm peering IPs and smoke test; Priya to post ticket updates; Omar to schedule week-1 check-in; Maya to prepare week-1 survey.
Ben (Eng): quick smoke test Ill run: curl -sS https://internal-ping.redwood.net/healthz -H 'Host: emberly-test' expecting 200 <300ms.
Priya (Support): posted initial log template in CS-4822. Add traces if >500ms.
Maya (Success Manager): short survey after week-1 demo; feeding results into health score. Current renewal risk: medium, dependent on pilot perf and network setup.
Omar (Sales): looping in Jen (billing) and scheduling demo for tomorrow 10am PT.
Liz (CS): thanks — Ill drop a summary and owners into CS-4822. If peering blocks, tag #eng-oncall for escalation.
